title: Nurse refill protocol: reserve fills for screened and attending patients
content:
**Protocol clause — Prescriptions & Renewals controlled renewals.**

The reserve fills combine missed visits and drug screening: where the patient has no missed visit with the prescribing department in the last 12 calendar months and a drug screen no more than 183 days before the renewal date, they are 2; where the patient has one or more missed visits with that department in those 12 months and a drug screen no more than 183 days before, they are 1; otherwise they are 0.

**Criteria.**
- *Missed visit* — a visit among the patient's In-Person Appointments with the department of the prescriber on this prescription, recorded as a no-show and scheduled within the 12 calendar months before the renewal date. A missed visit with another department does not count.
- *Drug screen no more than 183 days before* — the drug screen date recorded on the prescription is 183 or fewer calendar days before the renewal date; a prescription with no recorded drug screen does not meet it.

**Criteria table.**

| Missed visits with the prescribing department in 12 months | Drug screen within 183 days | Reserve fills |
|---|---|---|
| none | yes | 2 |
| one or more | yes | 1 |
| none | no | 0 |
| one or more | no | 0 |

**Cases (hypothetical).**
- Drug screen 183 days before, no no-shows with the department: 2. At 184 days: 0.
- Drug screen 40 days before, two no-shows with the department in the year: 1.
- Drug screen 40 days before, one no-show with a different department only: 2.
